sql:
SELECT e.status 
FROM event e 
JOIN budget b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event 
JOIN expense ex ON b.budget_id = ex.link_to_budget 
WHERE ex.expense_description = 'Post Cards, Posters' AND ex.expense_date = '2019-08-20'
